 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Impetunent'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Impertinent'.**
 
• The word '**Impertinent**' is an **adjective** which means 'not showing proper respect; rude'. **(गुस्ताख़/ढीठ)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The student was punished for his impertinent remarks to the teacher.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Impetunent'.**

• **Imperial -** relating to an empire **(शाही)**
 
• **Implication -** the conclusion that can be drawn from something although it is not explicitly stated **(निहितार्थ)**
 
• **Impetuous -** acting or done quickly and without thought or care **(अविवेकपूर्ण/उतावला)**
